loaded_loopback_update.scope: Both-mode finite loaded-pad loopback with optional simultaneous wired stress, identical 2x RX gain in baseline and impaired fixtures, relative-gain TX calibration and unchanged 10% screen. Gain is an ideal mathematical setting, not a physically qualified PGA.
loaded_loopback_update.next_action: Integrate and verify sustained exclusive-engine operation and inactive clock/bias shutdown. Extend loaded-quality coverage to wideband signals, gain headroom/settling/noise and supported tuning/loading envelopes before whole-chip closure.
loaded_loopback_update.gain_control_gap: Resolved in common mathematical chip by configure_rx_gain API and serialized command selecting existing 0.5/1/2 gain independently of filter tuning. Direct filter-state preservation, serialized selection/reserved encoding rejection, active-session rejection and TX-calibration rejection pass in fast-exclusive-engine.json. Pin-level RTL mapping and physical gain behavior remain open.

operating_policy_update.historical_four_path_tests: Optional stress evidence, not a product closure requirement.
